heading.en: Origins, studies and the civil service

body.zh-Hant: 焦利蒂1842年10月27日生於蒙多維（庫內奧省）。他1861年8月14日取得法學學位，1862年進入司法行政系統，1882年7月被任命為國務委員。他的國務委員任期只有數月，隨後便接受提名，參加第十五屆國會選舉。
body.en: Giolitti was born at Mondovì in the province of Cuneo on 27 October 1842. He took his law degree on 14 August 1861, entered the magistracy in 1862, and was appointed a councillor of state in July 1882. He held that post for only a few months before accepting a candidacy in the elections for the fifteenth legislature.

citations.quote: Nacque a Mondovì (Cuneo) il 27 ott. 1842
si laureò tre anni più tardi, il 14 ag. 1861
Nel 1862 entrò in magistratura
Nel luglio 1882 fu nominato consigliere di Stato
accettò la candidatura politica per le elezioni per la XV legislatura
incarico che ricoprì per pochi mesi

heading.en: Entry into Parliament and the 1892 mandate

body.zh-Hant: 1882年10月29日與11月5日的選舉中，焦利蒂以候選名單領頭人身分取得個人勝利並進入眾議院。他後來擔任克里斯皮第二次內閣的國庫部長，1890年12月9日請辭。1892年5月16日，國王決定把組成新政府的任務交給他。
body.en: In the elections of 29 October and 5 November 1882 Giolitti headed a list and won a personal success, entering the Chamber of Deputies. He later became Treasury minister in Crispi's second government and resigned on 9 December 1890. On 16 May 1892 the king decided to entrust him with forming the new government.

il G. ebbe un successo personale
ministro del Tesoro nel secondo governo Crispi
a rassegnare le dimissioni il 9 dic. 1890
il 16 maggio si risolse ad affidare l'incarico

heading.zh-Hant: 內政部長與「焦利蒂時代」
heading.en: Interior minister and the Giolittian age

body.zh-Hant: 焦利蒂在扎納德利內閣（1901年2月15日至1903年11月3日）擔任內政部長。他1906年5月29日組成第三屆內閣，任期到1909年12月11日，之後又在1911年3月30日至1914年3月21日再度領導政府。1911年9月29日義大利宣戰，展開對土耳其、奪取利比亞的戰爭。1914年3月4日他提出辭呈，並向國王推薦薩蘭德拉接任。
body.en: Giolitti was Interior minister in the Zanardelli government (15 February 1901 to 3 November 1903). He formed his third ministry on 29 May 1906 and stayed in office until 11 December 1909, then led the government again from 30 March 1911 to 21 March 1914. War was declared on 29 September 1911, in Italy's war against Turkey for the conquest of Libya. On 4 March 1914 he submitted his resignation and indicated Salandra to the king as his successor.

citations.quote: ministro dell'Interno nel governo Zanardelli (15 febbr. 1901 - 3 nov. 1903)
Il G. costituì il suo terzo ministero il 29 maggio 1906
fino all'11 dic. 1909
guidare il governo dal 30 marzo 1911 al 21 marzo 1914
La dichiarazione di guerra era stata fatta il 29 sett. 1911
per presentare le dimissioni il 4 marzo 1914
indicando egli stesso al re, come successore, Salandra
nella guerra contro la Turchia, per la conquista della Libia
definita dagli storici l'"età giolittiana"

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭中立與第五屆內閣
heading.en: Wartime neutrality and the fifth government

body.zh-Hant: 1915年4月26日政府簽訂倫敦條約。焦利蒂5月9日回到羅馬，10日向國王重申反對參戰的理由；5月18日他確信參戰已無可避免，離開首都退居卡沃爾，戰爭期間不再從政。1920年6月16日至1921年7月4日是他的第五屆內閣，期間以拉帕洛條約（1920年11月12日）解決與南斯拉夫的邊界問題。
body.en: The government signed the Pact of London on 26 April 1915. Giolitti returned to Rome on 9 May and on the 10th restated to the king his reasons against intervention; on 18 May, convinced intervention was now inevitable, he left the capital for Cavour and withdrew from politics for the rest of the war. His fifth government ran from 16 June 1920 to 4 July 1921, and with the Treaty of Rapallo (12 November 1920) it settled the border questions with Yugoslavia.

citations.quote: sottoscrivendo, il 26 apr. 1915, il patto di Londra
rientrò a Roma il 9 maggio
Ribadì al re, in un colloquio del 10 maggio, le sue ragioni contro l'intervento
Il 18, convinto ormai della inevitabilità dell'intervento
appartandosi dalla politica per tutto il periodo della guerra
Il quinto governo Giolitti (16 giugno 1920 - 4 luglio 1921)
con il trattato di Rapallo (12 nov. 1920)
i problemi di confine con la Jugoslavia
il G. lasciò la capitale, ritirandosi a Cavour

heading.en: The Fascist period and his last years

body.zh-Hant: 法西斯掌權後，焦利蒂支持採多數制的阿切爾博法，並擔任審查該改革草案的委員會主席。他拒絕加入1924年4月6日選舉中由法西斯黨主導的「全國大名單」，改提自己的名單。1925年12月21日他辭去庫內奧省議會議長與議員職務，並於1928年7月17日在卡沃爾去世。
body.en: After Fascism came to power Giolitti favoured the Acerbo law, which introduced a majoritarian system, and chaired the commission set up to examine the reform bill. He refused to stand on the Fascist-dominated 'listone nazionale' in the elections of 6 April 1924 and presented his own list instead. On 21 December 1925 he resigned as president and member of the Cuneo provincial council, and he died at Cavour on 17 July 1928.

citations.quote: fu favorevole alla legge Acerbo, che introduceva il sistema maggioritario

people.name: Aleksandras Stulginskis
people.nameZh: 亞歷山德拉斯·斯圖爾金斯基斯

body.zh-Hant: 斯圖爾金斯基斯1885年2月26日生於庫塔利村。他1908年從考納斯的薩莫吉希亞主教區神學院畢業，1910年進入德國哈雷大學農學院，1913年返回立陶宛，在維爾紐斯土地整理委員會擔任農藝師。
body.en: Aleksandras Stulginskis was born on 26 February 1885 in the village of Kutaliai. He graduated in 1908 from the Samogitian diocesan priests' seminary in Kaunas, entered the Agricultural Institute of the University of Halle in Germany in 1910, returned to Lithuania in 1913 and worked as an agronomist on the Vilnius land-management commission.

1913 m. grįžo į Lietuvą

heading.en: Party work and the Act of Independence

body.zh-Hant: 1917年秋天，他參與重建立陶宛基督教民主黨，並成為該黨首任領導人。1918年2月16日，他與立陶宛委員會的其他成員一同簽署了重建獨立立陶宛國家的決議，即《獨立宣言》。1919年底天主教性質的立陶宛農民聯盟成立後，他被選為主席。
body.en: In autumn 1917 he took part in re-founding the Lithuanian Christian Democratic Party and was its first leader. On 16 February 1918 he signed, together with the other members of the Council, the resolution restoring the independent state of Lithuania, known as the Act of Independence. When the Catholic Lithuanian Farmers' Union was founded at the end of 1919, he was elected its chairman.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年12月26日起，他在第二屆謝列維丘斯內閣任無任所部長；1919年3月12日起，在多維代蒂斯內閣任副總理，並兼任內政、糧食與公共工程部長，3月19日至4月12日實際領導內閣。1919年4月12日起，他在第四屆謝列維丘斯內閣任農業與國有財產部長，至10月7日。
body.en: From 26 December 1918 he was minister without portfolio in the second Šleževičius cabinet. From 12 March 1919 he was deputy prime minister and minister of the interior, food supply and public works in the Dovydaitis cabinet, and from 19 March to 12 April he in practice headed the cabinet. From 12 April 1919 until 7 October he was minister of agriculture and state property in the fourth Šleževičius cabinet.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年5月15日，他當選制憲議會議長；6月19日起接掌共和國總統職權。1922年12月21日議會選他為立陶宛共和國總統，他當天宣誓就職；1923年1月9日他放棄議員席位。他擔任總統直到1926年6月7日。
body.en: On 15 May 1920 he was elected chairman of the Constituent Seimas and from 19 June 1920 he took over the powers of President of the Republic. On 21 December 1922 the Seimas elected him President of Lithuania and he took the oath the same day; on 9 January 1923 he gave up his seat in the Seimas. He served as President until 7 June 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 他在1926年6月9日起成為第三屆議會議員。1926年12月17日政變後，議會主席團辭職，他被選為議長，任期從12月19日到1927年4月12日；4月12日他不得不宣讀總統斯梅托納解散第三屆議會的命令。
body.en: He became a member of the Third Seimas on 9 June 1926. After the coup of 17 December 1926 the Seimas Presidium resigned and he was elected chairman, serving from 19 December to 12 April 1927; on 12 April he had to read out President Smetona's act dissolving the Third Seimas.

heading.en: Withdrawal from politics and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1927年他淡出政治生活，定居於自己位於約庫巴瓦莊園的農場，專心務農。蘇聯占領立陶宛後，他於1941年6月被逮捕並押走；1956年返回立陶宛。他1969年9月22日在考納斯去世。
body.en: In 1927 he withdrew from political life, settled on his own farm at the Jokūbavas manor and devoted himself to farming. After the Soviet Union occupied Lithuania he was arrested and taken away in June 1941; he returned to Lithuania in 1956. He died in Kaunas on 22 September 1969.

heading.en: Origins, studies and training in France

body.zh-Hant: 阿吉雷·塞爾達1879年2月6日生於洛斯安第斯附近的波庫羅。他1900年畢業於教育學院，成為西班牙語教師，1904年取得智利大學律師資格。1910至1914年間，政府派他赴法國，在巴黎索邦大學進修行政與財政法，在法蘭西學院進修政治經濟與社會立法。1914年他回國復課，並當選全國教師協會主席。
body.en: Aguirre Cerda was born on 6 February 1879 at Pocuro, near Los Andes. He graduated as a Spanish-language teacher at the Pedagogical Institute in 1900 and qualified as a lawyer at the University of Chile in 1904. Between 1910 and 1914 the government commissioned him to specialise in administrative and financial law at the Sorbonne in Paris and in political economy and social legislation at the Collège de France. Back in Chile in 1914 he resumed teaching and was elected president of the national teachers' society.

body.zh-Hant: 阿吉雷·塞爾達1915年當選聖費利佩、普塔恩多與洛斯安第斯選區的眾議員，1918年改以聖地牙哥選區連任，任期至1921年。1918年桑富恩特斯政府時期，他出任司法與公共教育部長，任期為1月18日至9月6日，推動《義務初等教育法》。
body.en: Aguirre Cerda was elected deputy for San Felipe, Putaendo and Los Andes in 1915, and in 1918 was re-elected for Santiago for a term running to 1921. Under the Sanfuentes government in 1918 he served as Minister of Justice and Public Instruction, from 18 January to 6 September, and pushed the Compulsory Primary Instruction Law.

heading.zh-Hant: 內政部長、參議員與流亡

body.zh-Hant: 1920年亞歷山德里總統請他組織第一屆內閣，他在1920年12月23日至1921年8月16日擔任內政部長，任內遇上聖格雷戈里奧硝石礦場的屠殺事件。1921年他當選康塞普西翁的參議員。1924年他兩度重掌內政部，分別為1月3日至2月1日、7月20日至9月5日；9月11日軍政委員會下令關閉國會，提前結束他的國會任期。其後他流亡歐洲一年，1925年回國，1927年再度離開。
body.en: In 1920 President Alessandri called on him to organise his first cabinet, and he was Minister of the Interior from 23 December 1920 to 16 August 1921, facing the San Gregorio nitrate-works massacre. In 1921 he was elected senator for Concepción. In 1924 he held the Interior portfolio twice more, from 3 January to 1 February and from 20 July to 5 September; on 11 September the junta decreed the closing of Congress, cutting short his parliamentary term. He then went into exile in Europe for a year, returned in 1925 and left again in 1927.

heading.zh-Hant: 急進黨主席與總統任期
heading.en: Radical Party president and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1934年阿吉雷·塞爾達當選急進黨主席。1937年11月他經黨內選舉成為總統預備候選人，1938年4月在反對亞歷山德里的各黨大會上獲正式提名，競選口號是「治理就是教育」。他於1938年10月25日當選，同年12月24日就任總統，1941年11月25日在任內去世。
body.en: In 1934 Aguirre Cerda was elected president of the Radical Party. In November 1937 an internal party election made him a pre-candidate for the presidency, and in April 1938 he was proclaimed the official candidate at a broad convention of the parties opposed to Alessandri, campaigning under the slogan 'To govern is to educate'. He was elected on 25 October 1938 and took office as President on 24 December of that year; he died in office on 25 November 1941.
